ānŭlārĭus , a, um, adj. id.,
I.of or pertaining to a signet-ring: “creta = anulare (v. anularis),” Vitr. 7, 14 : * Scalae anulariae, a place in Rome, in the eighth district (the origin of the name is unknown), Suet. Aug. 72.—Hence, subst.: ānŭlārĭus , ii, m., a ring-maker, Cic. Ac. 2, 26, 86.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
